# Steven Wilen

> Printed QR listing cards for real estate agents in Ponte Vedra and Nocatee, Florida (St. Johns County). Each card carries the listing photo, the agent's name, brokerage and phone number, and a QR code that opens the listing page. One person, Steven Wilen, designs every card.

## Offer

- 50 cards and a one-page listing site for that listing: $90
- 50 cards only, with the QR code linked to a page the agent already uses (their site or the MLS listing): $40
- Cards are 3.5 × 2 in on 65 lb stock
- Dropped off in person around Ponte Vedra and Nocatee; mailed anywhere else
- If a mistake on the card is Steven's, he reprints it free

## How it works

1. The agent texts the listing address or a link (for cards only, also the QR destination)
2. Steven sends a proof to check the name, number and address
3. Nothing prints until the agent says "approved"
4. Cards are dropped off locally or mailed
